effect_description_eng:
＜Security A. +1＞ (This Digimon checks 1 additional security card.)
＜Partition (Yellow Lv.6 & Purple/Black Lv.6)＞ (When this Digimon with each of the specified digivolution cards would leave the battle area other than by your own effects or by battle, you may play 1 each of the specified cards without paying the costs.)
[When Digivolving] If DNA digivolving, until your opponent's turn ends, their effects don't affect this Digimon.
[When Digivolving] [When Attacking] 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -10000 DP until their turn ends.

[DNA Digivolve] Yellow Lv.6 + Purple/Black Lv.6: Cost 0 
Stack the 2 specified Digimon and digivolve unsuspended.
